records.jp: 春日さん、お野菜全部洗いました
records.en_original: Shiho, I've finished washing the vegetables.
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho, I've finished washing the vegetables.
records.en: Kasuga-san, I finished washing all the vegetables.

records.jp: ありがとうございます！　駒川さんが<CR>手伝ってくださって、大助かりです
records.en_original: Thank you, Uta! You've been a huge help.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Uta! You've been a huge help.
records.en: Thank you! Having you help me,<CR>Komagawa-san, is a huge help.

records.jp: やっぱまだ違和感ある？
records.en_original: Still not used to it, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Still not used to it, huh?
records.en: Still feels strange, huh?

records.jp: うむ。以前の詩ならばこんな風に<CR>一緒に料理するなんて考えられない
records.en_original: Indeed. I never would have imagined cooking with Uta like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. I never would have imagined cooking with Uta like this.
records.en: Indeed. With the old Uta, Kirara could never have imagined<CR>the two of us cooking together like this.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: 邪悪なオーラはないから信じていい、と思う
records.en_original: Her evil aura seems to not be present, so I think she can be trusted.
records.en_auxiliary: Her evil aura seems to not be present, so I think she can be trusted.
records.en: There's no wicked aura, so Kirara thinks she can be trusted.

records.jp: こうやって打ち解けられるなら、<CR>それに越したことはない
records.en_original: Breaking the ice like this might be the best way.
records.en_auxiliary: Breaking the ice like this might be the best way.
records.en: If we can get along like this,<CR>then that's all the better.

records.jp: 例え昔の敵であっても
records.en_original: Even if we used to be enemies.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if we used to be enemies.
records.en: Even if we used to be enemies.

records.jp: 私、お料理の中で食材を切る工程が一番好きなんです
records.en_original: Cutting ingredients is my favorite part of cooking.
records.en_auxiliary: Cutting ingredients is my favorite part of cooking.
records.en: Of all the steps in cooking, cutting the ingredients is my favorite.

records.jp: どうしてですか？
records.en_original: Why is that?
records.en_auxiliary: Why is that?
records.en: Why is that?

records.jp: 単純に切るという作業が楽しいっていうのも<CR>あるんですけど――
records.en_original: Cutting things is fun of course, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Cutting things is fun of course, but...
records.en: Part of it is just that cutting things is fun,<CR>but—

records.jp: 刃物を見ていると高揚感が湧くんですよね。<CR>なんででしょう？
records.en_original: There's something exhilarating about just looking at a blade. I wonder why that is?
records.en_auxiliary: There's something exhilarating about just looking at a blade. I wonder why that is?
records.en: Just looking at a blade gives me a little thrill.<CR>I wonder why?

records.jp: どうしたの？　二人とも
records.en_original: What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong?
records.en: What's wrong, you two?

records.jp: いや、わかっている。以前の詩とは違うと。<CR>わかってはいるのだが
records.en_original: I know she's not the same person she used to be, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I know she's not the same person she used to be, but...
records.en: No, Kirara understands. She knows Uta is different from before.<CR>Kirara knows, but...

records.jp: わたしは包丁はだいぶ慣れましたけど……<CR>刃物って、今でも少し怖いと感じます
records.en_original: I've used knives countless times while cooking, but I still think they're scary...
records.en_auxiliary: I've used knives countless times while cooking, but I still think they're scary...
records.en: I have gotten quite used to kitchen knives...<CR>but even now, blades still scare me a little.

records.jp: 怖い？<CR>どうしてですか？
records.en_original: Scary? Why is that?
records.en_auxiliary: Scary? Why is that?
records.en: Scare you?<CR>Why?

records.jp: 怪我しちゃうかもしれないって<CR>考えてしまって
records.en_original: I can't help but imagine getting cut.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't help but imagine getting cut.
records.en: I can't help thinking<CR>that someone might get hurt.

records.jp: なるほど。<CR>だからドキドキするんですかね
records.en_original: I see. That must be what excites me.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. That must be what excites me.
records.en: I see.<CR>Maybe that's why my heart races.

records.jp: あ、気づいちゃった
records.en_original: Uh oh.
records.en_auxiliary: Uh oh.
records.en: Ah, she figured it out.

records.jp: く、久野さんはどう感じます？
records.en_original: What do you think, Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think, Kirara?
records.en: K-Kuno-san, how do you feel about them?

records.jp: きららは……
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: 落ち着く。<CR>刃先に宿る職人の技を見ていると、背筋が伸びる
records.en_original: I feel calm. In every blade lies the heart of the craftsman who forged it.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel calm. In every blade lies the heart of the craftsman who forged it.
records.en: finds them calming.<CR>Seeing the craftsperson's skill dwelling in the blade makes Kirara sit up straighter.

records.jp: （鑑定士の目線じゃん）
records.en_original: (What is she, a critic or something?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What is she, a critic or something?)
records.en: (She sounds like an appraiser.)

records.jp: へー！　その考え方は新鮮です。<CR>星崎さんはどう感じますか？
records.en_original: Wow! What an interesting idea. What about you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! What an interesting idea. What about you, Ao?
records.en: Oh! That's an interesting way to look at it.<CR>How do you feel, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 怖い、かな
records.en_original: Scared, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: Scared, I guess.
records.en: I guess they scare me.

records.jp: ですよねー！<CR>星崎さんも同意見で安心しました。
records.en_original: Right?! I'm glad Ao and I are on the same page.
records.en_auxiliary: Right?! I'm glad Ao and I are on the same page.
records.en: Right!?<CR>I'm relieved Hoshizaki-san feels the same way.

records.jp: 料理とか戦闘で使うのは仕方ないですけど<CR>本来使わなくていいなら使いたくないですよね
records.en_original: I know they're used in cooking or in battle, but I'd prefer to not have to use one at all if I could.
records.en_auxiliary: I know they're used in cooking or in battle, but I'd prefer to not have to use one at all if I could.
records.en: I know we need them for cooking or battle,<CR>but I'd rather not use one at all if I didn't have to.

records.jp: 綿あめみたいな素材で切ったりできたらいいのに……
records.en_original: I wish I could just use something cute like a candy cane to cut ingredients instead.
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I could just use something cute like a candy cane to cut ingredients instead.
records.en: I wish we could cut things with something made of a material like cotton candy...

records.jp: いや、それはそれで怖くない？
records.en_original: That sounds pretty scary in its own way...
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds pretty scary in its own way...
records.en: Wouldn't that be scary in its own way?

records.jp: 落ち着く、かな。<CR>と言っても、職人技が光るような高級品なんて縁ないし
records.en_original: I guess I feel calm. Though I don't know anything about that stuff Kirara talked about.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I feel calm. Though I don't know anything about that stuff Kirara talked about.
records.en: I guess they calm me down.<CR>That said, I have never had anything to do with high-end pieces that showcase master craftsmanship.

records.jp: 見るとしたら、せいぜい包丁かカッターくらいかな
records.en_original: When I look at it, I just see a knife.
records.en_auxiliary: When I look at it, I just see a knife.
records.en: The most I ever see are kitchen knives and box cutters.

records.jp: 愛央ってもしかして中学生の頃、意味もなく<CR>学校鞄にカッターとか十徳ナイフ忍ばせてたタイプ？
records.en_original: Were you one of those kids who always had some kind of knife with her when you were growing up?
records.en_auxiliary: Were you one of those kids who always had some kind of knife with her when you were growing up?
records.en: Ao, were you the kind of middle schooler who kept a box cutter<CR>or a Swiss Army knife hidden in your school bag for no reason?

records.jp: ちっ、違うし！<CR>そこまで痛くないし！
records.en_original: N-no, nothing like that!
records.en_auxiliary: N-no, nothing like that!
records.en: N-no, I was not!<CR>I was not that cringe!

records.jp: （考えたことはあるけど）
records.en_original: (I did think about it, though.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I did think about it, though.)
records.en: (Though I did think about it.)

records.jp: 恥ずかしいことではない。<CR>通る人は通る道
records.en_original: It's nothing to be embarrassed about. To each their own.
records.en_auxiliary: It's nothing to be embarrassed about. To each their own.
records.en: It's nothing to be ashamed of.<CR>Some people just go through that phase.

records.jp: いいよ慰めなくてぇ……
records.en_original: You don't need to try and cheer me up...
records.en_auxiliary: You don't need to try and cheer me up...
records.en: You don't have to comfort me...

records.jp: でも興奮するのちょっとわかるかも
records.en_original: I can see how it could get someone excited.
records.en_auxiliary: I can see how it could get someone excited.
records.en: But I might understand the excitement a little.

records.jp: 本当ですか？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: これ持ってる時に後ろからドン！　って押されたら<CR>刺さっちゃうかも……とか考えちゃうよね
records.en_original: Like... If someone were to come behind you and push you, you might accidentally stab yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Like... If someone were to come behind you and push you, you might accidentally stab yourself.
records.en: When you're holding one, you can't help thinking,<CR>'What if someone shoved me from behind and I stabbed someone...?'

records.jp: ですよね！<CR>わかってくださって嬉しいです！
records.en_original: Yes! I'm so happy you understand!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes! I'm so happy you understand!
records.en: Exactly!<CR>I'm glad you understand!

records.jp: （こんな話題でピュアに喜ばれると困っちゃうよ）
records.en_original: (It's a little unsettling to see such pure joy from such a morbid topic.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's a little unsettling to see such pure joy from such a morbid topic.)
records.en: (It's kind of awkward when she's this excited about a topic like this.)

records.jp: でも皆さん色々な感じ方があるんですね
records.en_original: It seems that people have their own unique thoughts on things.
records.en_auxiliary: It seems that people have their own unique thoughts on things.
records.en: Still, everyone feels something different about them.

records.jp: ええ、どう感じるかは人それぞれですし<CR>その人の自由です
records.en_original: Yeah, how you choose to feel about it is up to you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, how you choose to feel about it is up to you.
records.en: Yeah. Everyone feels differently about things,<CR>and that's up to them.

records.jp: でも一つだけ破ってはいけないのは
records.en_original: But there's one rule you can't break.
records.en_auxiliary: But there's one rule you can't break.
records.en: But there's one rule you can never break.

records.jp: 傷つけるために使ってはいけないということです。<CR>他人も、自分も
records.en_original: It can't be used to hurt people. This applies to yourself, and others.
records.en_auxiliary: It can't be used to hurt people. This applies to yourself, and others.
records.en: You must not use them to hurt anyone.<CR>Neither other people nor yourself.

records.jp: 他人はなんとなく理解できますが、<CR>なんで自分もだめなんですか？
records.en_original: I understand not hurting other people, but why not yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: I understand not hurting other people, but why not yourself?
records.en: I can more or less understand why not other people,<CR>but why is hurting yourself wrong too?

records.jp: わたしたちが悲しいからです
records.en_original: Because that will make us sad.
records.en_auxiliary: Because that will make us sad.
records.en: Because it would make us sad.

records.jp: わかりました。守ります
records.en_original: Understood. I'll be careful.
records.en_auxiliary: Understood. I'll be careful.
records.en: I understand. I will obey that rule.
